Guardian Veterinary Specialists is an independently owned, full-service 24/7 emergency and specialty care veterinary hospital in Brewster, New York. Our entire team is dedicated to providing the very best and most progressive care to all our patients, and courteous service to our clients and primary care partners. 

At Guardian, you’ll find a state-of-the-art facility, skilled and compassionate veterinarians, a commitment to the community, and an overarching mission to say “yes” to helping as many pets as possible - including yours.
